Completion evidence for merged fix:

- Gerrit change 3001, revision `0999781728f41ea059d40f42f064d6f8c69edb8d`, earned `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; submit returned MERGED.
- Merged commit: `cc4a23a2405b752a0d9587720f9295ec72871372` (`Fix verify-identity checkout pack measurement`).
- Live `Verify Authorship Identity` workflow run `35505599913` completed with conclusion `success` on `cc4a23a2405b752a0d9587720f9295ec72871372`; job `verify-identity (authenticated-authorship gate)` succeeded, including `Fetch full code ref history`, `Measure the blobless checkout pack`, `verify-identity (gating)`, `verify-opcert (required-environment op-cert gate)`, and `Fail closed if the blobless checkout pack exceeds its limit`.
- Local pre-push `make verify` on this exact change produced `17 failed, 20238 passed, 126 skipped in 1499.00s`; all 17 failures were the known macOS arm64 host packaging defect where `pypandoc-binary==1.17` ships an x86_64 `pandoc` (`Bad CPU type in executable`). CI's Linux gating cell is unaffected and voted `Verified +1`.
- Targeted merged-revision pytest command, run from a `git archive` extraction with `PYTHONPATH` pinned to that extracted tree, completed: `13 passed in 1.83s`.
